name: B3D_InstAlloc
returns: int: new node handle, 0 on failure
summary: Allocates a new empty 3D instance node (no body) and returns its handle.
semantics: Node::Alloc: zeroed Node, handle from the node map (hashMapAutoId), bodyId -1, identity rotation, scale 1.0, size 0, saturation/colour modifiers 1.0, hue 0; linked into the render manager's unattached list (in no scene). Returns the handle, or 0 when memory or the handle fail. The node is owned by the engine until B3D_InstFree; it is not saved with script variables (only the B3D world block of the savegame keeps nodes). Arguments ignored. Typical use: B3D_InstAlloc, B3D_InstSetBody, B3D_InstAddToScene or B3D_InstAddToInst.

name: B3D_LightAlloc
returns: int: new light node handle, 0 on failure
summary: Allocates a new light node (Light flag, no body) and returns its handle.
semantics: Scene::AllocLightNode: like B3D_InstAlloc but the node gets the Light flag 0x4 and no body; it is a light only once added to a scene and given parameters (B3D_LightSetParameters/Color/Range/Attenuation/Pos). Returns the handle or 0. Free with B3D_LightFree (same code as B3D_InstFree).

name: B3D_InstFree
summary: Frees a node and, recursively, all its children.
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Found: Node::ReleaseNode - frees its UV animation storage and GPU buffer, notifies a pending J3D animation callback (a task waiting in J3D_JobStart/JobPlay on it is resumed with code 3), releases all children recursively, detaches it from its scene, frees its link table, lens records, names and the node itself, and removes the handle from the map. The handle is dead afterwards (reusing it in other natives returns "not found", except B3D_InstFind/CameraFind continuation which crashes, see there). Not found: nothing. Always answers 0.

name: B3D_InstSetBody
summary: Assigns a body (3D model) to a node by body id; returns 1 on success.
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. body = body id (from B3D_GetBodyID or a numeric id). Scene::SetNodeModel: if the node already has this same non-zero body it returns 1 without change. Else AP: body < 0 -> 0. Mesh::GetBody(body) (loads the body if needed) NULL -> 0. Otherwise: flagged child nodes released, render resources released (if in an enabled scene), UV animation and extra buffers freed, bodyId set, size = body LOD0 scale, scale reset to 1.0, radius = size, name = body name; body flag 0x40 sets node Hidden + NoCollisionTree, body flag 0x8 sets flags2 0x20; body texture animations collected; collision trees built for LODs flagged 0x10; render resources acquired again in an enabled scene. Returns 1. Node not found -> 0.
fl: differs: FL Scene::SetNodeModel (0x004a35e0) has no body < 0 test, a negative id goes straight to Mesh::GetBody (expected NULL -> 0; not verified in FL)
x3_src: differs: B155 - a node with a fixed LOD (B3D_InstSetSizeUsed) gets lodIndex clamped to the new body's last LOD (the original kept it and the renderer read past the LOD array); also the remake keeps a use count on the body (holdBody), not observable

name: B3D_LightFree
summary: Frees a light node (same as B3D_InstFree).
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Same code as B3D_InstFree (Scene::ReleaseNode, recursive). Always 0.

name: B3D_CameraAlloc
returns: int: new camera handle, 0 on failure
summary: Allocates a new camera node and returns its handle.
semantics: Scene::AllocCameraNode: zeroed Camera (a Node with Camera flag 0x1), handle from the node map, identity rotation, viewport left/top 0 and right/bottom 1.0 (16.16), focus = quarter turn (0x4000), layer (priority) 0, view scale X/Y 0, no caustic animation; in the unattached list. Returns the handle or 0. Add to a scene with B3D_CameraAddToScene; free with B3D_CameraFree.

name: B3D_CameraFree
summary: Frees a camera node.
semantics: cam = camera handle (Scene::FindEnabledNodeById: the node map lookup that also requires the node's Camera flag 0x1; a plain node or light handle -> not found). Found: Scene::ReleaseCamera - notifies a pending J3D animation callback (waiting task resumed with code 3), frees its lens-flare records and caustic animation record, detaches it from its scene and frees it; handle dead afterwards. Not found: nothing. Always 0.

name: B3D_SceneAlloc
returns: int: new scene handle, 0 on failure
summary: Creates a new empty 3D scene and returns its handle.
semantics: Scene::CreateScene: allocates a Scene, gets a handle from the scene map, links it into the render manager's scene list; zeroed, then system scale 0.01 (the cockpit scene scale, see B3D_SceneSetSystemScale), ambient 0x20, no nodes or cameras, flags 0 (not enabled: nothing is rendered or GPU-resident until B3D_SceneEnable). Returns the handle or 0. Free with B3D_SceneFree.

name: B3D_SceneClear
summary: Detaches all nodes and cameras from a scene without freeing them.
semantics: scene = scene handle (Scene::SceneFromHandle, scene map; unknown -> not found). Found: Scene::DetachAllFromScene - every root node is detached (Scene::DetachNodeFromScene: GPU buffers/render resources released, node moved to the unattached list, children follow) and every camera detached (viewport state freed). The nodes and cameras stay allocated and keep their handles; the script still owns them. Always 0.

name: B3D_SceneFree
summary: Destroys a scene together with all its nodes and cameras.
semantics: scene = scene handle (Scene::SceneFromHandle, scene map; unknown -> not found). Found: Scene::DestroyScene - every root node is released (Scene::ReleaseNode, recursive, as B3D_InstFree), every camera detached and released (as B3D_CameraFree), render resources released, the scene handle removed, its name and the scene freed. All handles of those nodes/cameras become dead. Always 0.

name: B3D_SceneEnable
summary: Enables a scene: builds GPU meshes, light records and camera viewports so it is rendered.
semantics: scene = scene handle (Scene::SceneFromHandle, scene map; unknown -> not found). Found: Scene::AcquireSceneRenderResources - if scene flag bit 0 is already set, nothing; else sets it, creates viewport state for each camera (camera flag bit 0), builds the GPU mesh of each node's body (or a light record for light nodes) and recursively for children. Nodes added to an enabled scene later get their resources at once. Always 0.

name: B3D_SceneDisable
summary: Disables a scene: releases its render resources (meshes, viewports); the scene and nodes stay.
semantics: scene = scene handle (Scene::SceneFromHandle, scene map; unknown -> not found). Found: Scene::ReleaseSceneRenderResources - if scene flag bit 0 is set: releases the render resources of all nodes and children, frees camera viewports (clears camera flag bit 0), clears scene flag bit 0. Not rendered afterwards. Always 0.

name: B3D_InstAddToScene
summary: Puts a node (and its subtree) into a scene as a root node.
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. scene = scene handle (Scene::SceneFromHandle, scene map; unknown -> not found). Both found: Scene::AttachNodeToScene - detaches the node from its current scene, unlinks it from its parent (it becomes a root), appends it to the scene's root node list, propagates the scene to its children; if the scene is enabled (flag bit 0) the subtree's render resources are acquired. Either not found: nothing. Always 0. Also used for lights (B3D_LightAddToScene, same code).

name: B3D_InstDeleteFromScene
summary: Removes a node (and its subtree) from a scene without freeing it.
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. scene = scene handle (Scene::SceneFromHandle, scene map; unknown -> not found). Both found: Scene::DetachNodeFromScene - only if the node is in that scene: GPU buffer and (enabled scene) render resources of the node and children released; a root node moves to the unattached list (a child stays under its parent); node scene cleared. Node stays allocated. Always 0.

name: B3D_LightAddToScene
summary: Puts a light node into a scene (same as B3D_InstAddToScene).
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. scene = scene handle (Scene::SceneFromHandle, scene map; unknown -> not found). Same code as B3D_InstAddToScene (Scene::AttachNodeToScene); in an enabled scene a node with the Light flag gets its light record allocated. Always 0.

name: B3D_LightDeleteFromScene
summary: Removes a light node from a scene (same as B3D_InstDeleteFromScene).
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. scene = scene handle (Scene::SceneFromHandle, scene map; unknown -> not found). Same code as B3D_InstDeleteFromScene. Always 0.

name: B3D_CameraAddToScene
summary: Attaches a camera to a scene (appended to its camera list).
semantics: cam = camera handle (Scene::FindEnabledNodeById: the node map lookup that also requires the node's Camera flag 0x1; a plain node or light handle -> not found). scene = scene handle (Scene::SceneFromHandle, scene map; unknown -> not found). Both found: Scene::AttachCamera - detaches it from its old scene, appends it to the scene's camera list (the first camera is the one B3D_SceneGetCamera / B3D_SceneSetViewPort use), creates its viewport state if the scene is enabled. Always 0.

name: B3D_CameraDeleteFromScene
summary: Detaches a camera from a scene without freeing it.
semantics: cam = camera handle (Scene::FindEnabledNodeById: the node map lookup that also requires the node's Camera flag 0x1; a plain node or light handle -> not found). scene = scene handle (Scene::SceneFromHandle, scene map; unknown -> not found). Both found: Scene::DetachCamera(scene, cam) - in an enabled scene frees the camera's viewport state and clears camera flag bit 0; moves the camera to the unattached list. Note: it does not check that the camera is in that scene. Always 0.

name: B3D_InstAddToInst
summary: Makes a node the child of another node (moves it out of its scene/old parent).
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. arg1 = child, arg2 = parent (both node handles). Both found: Scene::AttachChildNode - the child is detached from its scene, unlinked from its old parent/list, appended to the parent's children, parent subtree radius invalidated; if the parent is in a scene the scene is propagated and, in an enabled scene, the child subtree's render resources are acquired. Child position/rotation are then relative to the parent. No cycle check (attaching a node to its own descendant corrupts the tree). Always 0.
bugs: no check against attaching a node under itself or its own descendant; the subtree is unlinked from the tree and loops back on itself. AP 0x00494685 (Scene::AttachChildNode), FL 0x004b087c. Script sees: later recursive walks (render, free) loop or never reach the subtree (deduced from the code, not run). x3_src: reproduces.

name: B3D_SetEngineFlags
summary: ORs bits into the 3D engine flags and returns the result.
semantics: RenderManager+0x24 |= arg1; answers the new value. Known bits: 0x1 frame recording active (also records texture draws), 0x2 frame replay active, 0x20 cut-file names in use, 0x80 engine-internal; the rest are not named. Setting 0x1/0x2 by hand fakes a recording/replay state without a recorder (B3D_InitRecording/InitReplay then refuse, ExitRecording/ExitReplay run on a NULL recorder - safe, they only clear). Values are read as raw cell dwords; cell types are not checked.

name: B3D_ClearEngineFlags
summary: Clears bits of the 3D engine flags and returns the result.
semantics: RenderManager+0x24 &= ~arg1; answers the new value. Bits as B3D_SetEngineFlags.

name: B3D_GetEngineFlags
summary: Returns the 3D engine flags word.
semantics: Answers RenderManager+0x24 (bits as B3D_SetEngineFlags). Same code as B3D_GetFlags. Arguments ignored.

name: B3D_InstSetPos
summary: Sets a node's position (relative to its parent or scene origin).
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Found: node pos = (x, y, z), raw engine length units (500 per metre in the world; scenes built by scripts use the same integer units). Local to the parent node for a child. No other update (world position is recomputed by the next transform walk). Always 0.

name: B3D_InstSetRot
summary: Sets a node's rotation from three angles.
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Found: Node::SetRotationAngles builds the node rotation matrix from the three angles (engine angle units, 0x10000 = full turn; same Euler order as SE angle helpers / B3D_CameraSetOrientation's first triple). Always 0.

name: B3D_InstCopyRot
summary: Copies the rotation matrix of one node to another.
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Both found: dst rotation (3x4 words, node+0x40, 48 bytes) = src rotation. Always 0.

name: B3D_LightSetPos
summary: Sets a light node's position and refreshes its light record.
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Found: pos = (x, y, z) as B3D_InstSetPos; if the node has a light record (it is a light in an enabled scene) Light::FillLightRecord refreshes it. Always 0.

name: B3D_LightSetColor
summary: Sets a light's colour (0..255 per channel, or 0..65535 scaled down).
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Found: if r, g and b are all <= 255 (signed compare) they are stored as is (16-bit words, node +0x150..); if any is > 255, all three are taken as (v >> 8) & 0xff (16-bit channel values). Light record refreshed if present. Negative values pass the <=255 test and are stored as negative words. Always 0.

name: B3D_LightSetRange
summary: Sets a light's range.
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Found: light range = arg (engine length units), light record refreshed if present. Always 0.

name: B3D_LightSetParameters
summary: Applies a light type from the light-type table to a node (sets its light kind flags).
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Found: Node::ApplyBodyTypeFlags(type): if type < 1000 (unsigned), light type record type of the render manager's light system: kind 1 sets flag LightDirectional 0x800000, 2 LightPoint 0x400000, 3 LightSpot 0x10; a body-type value > 0 sets BodyTypedLight 0x20000 and stores it; value8 > 0 sets 0x80000. name: B3D_SceneGetCamera
summary: Returns the first camera of a scene.
semantics: scene = scene handle (Scene::SceneFromHandle, scene map; unknown -> not found). Answers the handle of the first camera in the scene's camera list (the first one added), 0 if the scene has no camera or is not found.

name: B3D_InstSetSize
summary: Sets a node's uniform size, rescaling its children proportionally.

Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Always 0.

semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Found: Scene::SetNodeScale: scale = (sx, sy, sz) 16.16 (0x10000 = 1.0), radius = size * max(sx, sy, sz), subtree radius invalidated; children with flag ScaledChild 0x40 get the same scale (recursively). Always 0.

name: B3D_InstSetOverrideEffect
returns: int: 1 if the node was found, else 0
summary: Sets a material override effect on a node and its whole subtree.
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Found: Scene::SetSubtreeOverrideEffect(mode): mode 1 -> override -4, 2 -> -3, 3 -> -2, 4 -> -1, 8 -> -6, anything else (0 included) -> 0 (no override); stored on the node and every descendant, and each node's override parameter (B3D_InstSetAlphaOverride value) is reset to 0. The visual meaning of the codes is not named (alpha/fade style overrides used by the GUI). Answers 1 (the function always returns true); 0 if the node is not found.

Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. The parameter is ignored; nothing is stored. Answers 1 if the node is found, 0 otherwise.

name: B3D_InstSetAlphaOverride

summary: Sets a node's override parameter (alpha 0..255 for the alpha override effect); this node only.
semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Found: node override parameter (+0x13c) = value; answers value. Not found: 0. The renderer uses it as alpha value/255 (blended, no z-write) when the node has flags2 0x8000000 and value != 0, and as the parameter of B3D_InstSetOverrideEffect modes. Children are not changed (see B3D_InstSetAlphaOverrideRecursive). Note B3D_InstSetOverrideEffect resets it to 0.

semantics: inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Answers node+0x13c (set by B3D_InstSetAlphaOverride*); 0 when not found.

name: B3D_GetTextureID
summary: Returns the texture id for a texture name, registering the name if it is new.
semantics: argc < 2: mark = 0, else mark = arg2. Texture::GetNamedTexture(CellGetString(arg1), mark): six GUI texture names are answered from a cache; otherwise TextureRuntime::NameToId - an existing name gives its id; a new name is registered (the file is not loaded yet - it loads on first use) and, if mark is non-zero, gets entry flags 0x10008000; -1 when the name table cannot grow. Result is sign-extended int16. Ids are what B3D_Tex* drawing natives and B3D_PreCacheTexture take.

name: B3D_CameraCalcFOV
summary: Computes the focus/FOV value that makes an object of a given width fill the view at a distance.
semantics: cam = camera handle (Scene::FindEnabledNodeById: the node map lookup that also requires the node's Camera flag 0x1; a plain node or light handle -> not found). The camera is only checked for existence (its fields are not used). Answers (int) min(2500, atan2(width/65536 / ((dist/65536) * (scale * 0.01)), 1) * 10000/pi) (x87 80-bit, truncation). width and dist are 16.16, scale an integer percent-like factor (0.01 = the cockpit scene scale). Units of the result: 10000 = pi radians, so 2500 = 45 degrees. 0 when the camera is not found. A zero denominator gives atan2(inf) = 5000 -> clamped 2500.

name: B3D_InitRecording
summary: Starts recording the 3D frames into "<name>.rec" (if neither recording nor replaying).
semantics: If engine flags & 3 == 0: Save::StartFrameRecording(name) - creates the recorder, opens the gzip file <name>.rec (user folder) for writing, sets engine flag 0x1, writes the RECO/RNAM/RFRA header; from then each frame's scene changes and texture draws are recorded. Result of the start is ignored: answers 0 in every case (also when already recording/replaying, then nothing happens). Stop with B3D_ExitRecording.

name: B3D_ExitRecording
summary: Stops frame recording (writes the end tag and closes the file).
semantics: If engine flag 0x1: Save::StopFrameRecording - writes "REND", frees caches, file and recorder, clears 0x1. Always 0.

name: B3D_InitReplay
args: name:string, layerBias:int, left:int, right:int, top:int, bottom:int
summary: Starts replaying a frame recording "<name>.rec" into a viewport rectangle.
semantics: If engine flags & 3 == 0: Save::StartFramePlayback(name, layerBias, left, right, top, bottom): opens <name>.rec, sets engine flag 0x2, checks the RECO/RNAM/RFRA header, loads the body names; recorded camera viewports are mapped into the 16.16 rectangle (left, right, top, bottom) and layerBias is added to recorded camera layers. Answers its result; 0 when already recording/replaying. In the ORIGINAL the RNAM tag is compared over 5 bytes of a 4-byte buffer, so the check always fails and a recording never plays; on that failure the player and flag 0x2 stay set (B3D_ExitReplay needed before any new Init).

AP Save::StartFramePlayback 0x00475b10 (call 0x00495b8c). Script sees: 0 from every replay; recording/replay natives refuse until B3D_ExitReplay. x3_src: fixed (4-byte compare; a failed start cleans up). bugs.md: B14 (bugs_fixed.md).

name: B3D_ExitReplay

semantics: If engine flag 0x2: Save::StopFramePlayback - releases the scenes, nodes and cameras the playback made, its caches, file and player; clears 0x2. Always 0.

name: B3D_TexTextBlock
args: tex:int, text:string, font:int, x:int, y:int, right:int, color:int, flags:int
returns: int: number of lines drawn (0 on failure)
summary: Draws word-wrapped text into a texture between x and right; returns the line count.
semantics: tex = texture id (B3D_GetTextureID); a NEGATIVE id names a composite texture (texture animation row -id made of tiles): the operation is applied to every tile it overlaps, with coordinates in the composite's space. Textures whose material row has flag 0x10000 (font-scaled) take coordinates in logical units, multiplied by the engine font scale. font = font slot 0..9 returned by B3D_OpenFont. arg2 must be a string cell (type 2 or 0x0b), else 0 and nothing drawn. right <= 0: for a composite tex right += its rightmost tile edge; for a plain tex with the font-scale material flag right += width/fontScale, WITHOUT the flag right = surface width (the negative offset is dropped). The text is wrapped (Font::WrapTextLines, max 100 lines) to (right - x) * fontScale, the style passes of flags (style mask) are built, and each line is drawn with Font::TexTextLine at y + i * lineStep (lineStep = cell height + style extent, / fontScale). flags = style bits (shadow/outline/bold etc.) plus wrap options. Answers the number of lines.
